item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The upper-air disturbance now affecting the coast of southern China will depart gradually today and tomorrow. It will be brighter, but there will still be a few showers over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to Guangdong later on Monday and on Tuesday. A strong easterly airstream is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific is expected to move in the general direction of the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days.
